| The heatmap grid always fits its box (592) | — no check named in the section |
| The date strip is as wide as its slot, at every width (606) | the ribbon rescales with its slot (2403) |
| The intro sweeps the range end from one end of the strip to the other (639) | — no check named in the section |
| The window's travel is what the history exceeds the window by (668) | — no check named in the section |
| The window pill centres on the pointer's PIXEL, not its date (693) | — no check named in the section |
